title: I. Betriebsform: the floor reconfigures
event: The main hall of the Kaufhaus silently changes its circulation: square display islands rotate in place and lock into a continuous serpentine channel, polished floor panels slide to close side aisles and form a single long queue that funnels toward the central produce bay. Overhead lamps shift from cool to amber in a measured beat that syncs the rotations.
consequence: a continuous serpentine queue of rotated display islands and a glossy funneled path across the main floor
nextHook: the glossy funnel will gather soft matter and lead it toward the central aisle
stillPrompt: Wide still of the Kaufhaus main floor: display islands turned 45–90°, forming a tight snake of counters; the ceiling lamps glow amber in a soft band; absence of people. The architectural reconfiguration is the subject — no creatures, no text, no logos. Visible is the new glossy path reflecting the warm overhead bands.
videoPrompt: 5s slow tracking move through the newly formed serpentine queue: islands click into place, floor panels glide and seal side aisles, amber lamps pulse on each rotation. The camera moves along the glossy funnel toward the produce bay, revealing the channel that will collect residues. Keep the Kaufhaus interior recognizably the same building.
cameraCue: after event: crane forward along the funnel, low enough to catch reflections on the polished path, reveal the rotated islands framing the channel

title: II. Fleisc: soft goods behave like flesh
event: On the new serpentine islands, stacks of textiles slump as if desiccating; folded sweaters and soft garments peel into thick, fibrous sheets that slide across lacquered counters and drip viscous, colorless beads into the funneled path. The textiles keep their weave but behave like supple tissue, leaving a tactile smear along the glossy floor.
consequence: a glistening smear of fibrous material tracked along the glossy funnel toward the back alcove
nextHook: fibrous smear leads into a backstage alcove where stored objects will interact with it
stillPrompt: Close still of folded garments on a display island: fabrics slump and separate into fibrous sheets that glisten; small clear beads collect at the edges. No people, no creatures. The texture and wet sheen are emphasized; the Kaufhaus fixtures and lighting match the previous scene.
videoPrompt: 2s push-in: a hand is briefly implied by a ripple but no person is shown; the fibrous sheets slip from a pile, unfurl, and a bead falls into the glossy funnel. The camera lingers on the smear as it moves toward a shadowed alcove.
cameraCue: after event: macro push into the fibrous smear, follow its movement down the glossy path toward the alcove

title: III. H- und P-Sätze: the sculpture answers safety pulses
event: In a back storage alcove a weathered practical sculpture — built from scratched metal, stitched fabric patches and industrial foam — responds to intermittent overhead safety-phrase pulses emitted like percussion. Each pulse makes a seam along the sculpture's shoulder unlace; ribbonlike packing fibers and fibrous strips peel away and float down, falling in a precise arc that lands and adheres to the smear from the islands. The sculpture slowly rights itself onto a small rotating platform.
consequence: fibrous strips from the sculpture now interleaved with the floor smear, creating an identifiable trail of attached ribbons
nextHook: a member of the public will pick up a ribbon from the trail
stillPrompt: Still of a weathered practical sculpture in a shadowed Kaufhaus alcove: scratched metal frame, stitched upholstery patches, seams partly opened and thin ribbonlike packing fibers peeling free. The object is clearly a filmed, physical prop with surface wear and dust. Ribbons are mid-fall toward the smeared floor.
videoPrompt: 3s dolly: start tight on the smear, then pull back to reveal the sculpture on its rotating platform. As a rhythmic, clipped safety pulse occurs the sculpture's seams unlace and ribbons peel away, drifting and landing into the smear. Emphasize physical mechanics — creak of metal, fabric friction, slow rotation. No readable labels.
cameraCue: after event: slow dolly from the smear up and back to show the sculpture upright on the platform as ribbons settle

title: IV. Public: shoppers echo and ripple fixtures
event: Shoppers arrive and begin to murmur disjointed fragments of the clipped pulses; the collective murmur vibrates lighting rigs and causes mannequins to twitch as if responding. The crowd moves in a cautious tide along the serpentine channel created earlier. One shopper stoops and tucks a fibrous strip—one of those ribbons—into a coat pocket, then threads toward the escalator.
consequence: a shopper carrying a fibrous strip moves up the escalator toward the atrium
nextHook: the carried strip will trigger a security response and reawaken the sculpture in the atrium
stillPrompt: Mid-distance still of a Kaufhaus aisle filled with murmuring shoppers: mannequins at the edge of the serpentine channel twitch subtly; a single hand is shown picking up and pocketing a fibrous strip. No creatures shown. Lighting flickers in time with the murmured pulses.
videoPrompt: 2s handheld follow: move behind the shopper as they fold the strip into their coat and ride the escalator. The murmuring grows into an anxious chorus; ceiling lights stutter with the rhythm. Keep action internal to people and fixtures; do not show the sculpture.
cameraCue: after event: steadicam follow from behind the shopper up the escalator into the atrium, close on the hand in the pocket

title: V. Terror: barricades and a returned sculpture
event: The shopper's movement past a sensor sends a terse alarm through the store. Fixtures lurch: checkout counters tip and lock into angled barricades; clothing racks collapse to form slow-moving walls. The weathered practical sculpture suddenly appears at the center of the reconfigured atrium — not animated CGI but a large prop physically rolled into place by store automation — and uses the overturned displays as a base, standing like a sentinel. Shoppers recoil and scatter; the architectural flow ruptures into a narrow tunnel toward the emergency exit.
consequence: a tunnel of overturned displays and locked counters leads from the atrium toward the emergency exit, with the sculpture mounted at its mouth
nextHook: the tunnel will be reworked into a new consumption mechanism in the final transformation
stillPrompt: Still of the Kaufhaus atrium in upheaval: angled barricades of counters and racks create a tunnel; the weathered practical sculpture stands on a pile of fixtures at the tunnel mouth, lit by stuttering emergency lamps. The prop looks materially real — dented metal, fabric wraps, industrial fastenings. People are small figures in the background.
videoPrompt: 5s handheld then crane: shoppers scatter as counters lock and tip; the sculpture is rolled into the center and climbs atop the barricade, creaking as it settles. Sirens hum; smoke is minimal, theatrical. Emphasize the physicality of overturned fixtures and the sculpture's material surfaces. No readable text or logos.
cameraCue: after event: low-angle handheld push toward the sculpture, then crane through the formed tunnel to give depth to the barricade

title: VI. Konsum: the rupture resolves into a loop
event: The overturned tunnel is repurposed: checkout scanners hidden in the toppled counters begin to hum; shoppers, unsettled, start feeding the fibrous strips into slot-like gaps and passing items through the barricade like currency. The sculpture turns slowly on its platform and sorts goods onto a central spinning carousel assembled from display parts. The Kaufhaus circulation reconfigures again — not back to the original Betriebsform but into a circular consumption loop where the ribbons and strips act as tokens.
consequence: a slow-spinning central carousel of goods driven by the sculpture, with shoppers feeding ribbons into slot gaps — a new, uneasy Betriebsform
nextHook: the store now operates as a circular consumption machine; the original conflict remains unresolved in the altered system
stillPrompt: Still of a spinning carousel assembled from display parts at the Kaufhaus center: the weathered practical sculpture stands at the hub, hands and surfaces patched with consumer detritus; shoppers feed fibrous strips into narrow slots. The scene reads as a filmed tableau of a transformed interior.
videoPrompt: 2s 360° pan: circle the carousel as the sculpture turns it; shoppers pass items and slide strips into slots. The lights are steady but clinical; the motion resolves the previous panic into ritualized consumption. Emphasize tactile mechanics and the sculpture's worn surfaces.
cameraCue: after event: continuous 360-degree pan around the carousel, ending on a close-up of one strip sliding into a slot
